chunks: And Zurārah narrated from him, peace be upon him, that he said:
Regarding the vessels of the Magians, if you are compelled to use them, then wash them with water.

key_terms.اضْطُرِرْتُمْ: you were compelled or forced by necessity
key_terms.الْمَجُوسِ: the Magians; a non-Muslim religious community mentioned here in the context of their utensils

ai.seo_question: What should be done if one is compelled to use the vessels of the Magians?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about using the vessels of the Magians when necessity requires it. In such a case, the vessels are to be washed with water before use, indicating a practical ruling connected to taharah (ritual purity).

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4221 - And Zurara narrated from Imam (as), that He (as) said:
"Regarding the vessels of the Magians, if you are compelled to use them, then wash them with water."
